atoms.b: There are ((no ++ten more_than_ten)) tenths in one whole. So one tenth is ten times ((++smaller bigger)) than one whole.
In a tenth there are again ten ((ones tenths ++hundredths)). So ten hundredths ((are_smaller_than ++equals are_bigger_than)) one tenth: 10/100||=||++1 10 100/10
atoms.sound: In a tenth there are again ten hundredths. So ten hundredths equals one tenth.

atoms.b: If you take a closer look at a hundredth, you will see that there are ten ((tenths hundredths ++thousandths)) in it. So ten thousandths equals one hundredth: 10/1000||=||1/1 10 ++100
atoms.sound: If you take a closer look at a hundredth, you will see that there are ten thousandths in it. So ten thousandths equals one hundredth.

atoms.b: Thus, one tenth consists of ten ((tens ++hundredths thousandths)). And each of these hundredths consists of another ((++ten hundred thousand)) thousandths. So one tenth equals ten hundredths or one hundred thousandths: 1/10||=||1 ++10 100/100||=||1 10 ++100/1000
atoms.sound: Thus, one tenth consists of ten hundredths. And each of these hundredths consists of another ten thousandths. So one tenth equals ten hundredths or one hundred thousandths.
